facts.fact: The ITU repository lists the National Digital Development Plan (PNDN) as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of the National Digital Development Plan (PNDN) as 2021 - 2025.
The repository names the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications as lead/owner of the National Digital Development Plan (PNDN).
